acolyte: You devoted yourself to service in a temple, performing sacred rites and studying religion under a priest. This instruction and your deep devotion allowed you to channel a modicum of divine power for your place of worship and its visitors.
criminal: You have a history of breaking the law and maintaining ties within the criminal underworld. Accustomed to a life of illicit activity, you survive by flouting societal rules rather than following them.
sage: You spent years researching manuscripts, scrolls, and expert teachings to master fields like history, lore, or magic. Your expertise stems from studying the insights of those who came before you.
soldier: War and combat training have shaped your life, instilling discipline and survival skills. Whether serving in an army, militia, or mercenary company, the scars of the battlefield remain with you.
